youtube.title: Who gets in, who doesn't, and why? Check Admit Finder
youtube.description:
Admission isn't luck, it's a pattern. EduAbroad Admit Finder shows real students' accepted and rejected profiles, with GPA, GRE, IELTS or TOEFL and work experience. One profile had IELTS 9 and was still rejected. Score isn't everything. It's free, no login needed.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com/admit-finder

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
